BiblicalUsage: Heshmon is a town in the south of Judah, named once in the long list of the cities given to the tribe. It stands among the cities of the wilderness edge, a small name kept in the record of the inheritance.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even the smallest town in Judah's portion was given by God's own hand, and no part of the inheritance is too small to be recorded.
